import sys
data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
# Simple uudecode
lines = data.decode().split('\n')
result = bytearray()
for line in lines:
    if not line or line[0] == 'e' or line[0] == ' ':
        continue
    count = (ord(line[0]) - 32) & 0x3f
    i = 1
    while count > 0:
        chunk = line[i:i+4]
        if len(chunk) < 4:
            break
        a = (ord(chunk[0]) - 32) & 0x3f
        b = (ord(chunk[1]) - 32) & 0x3f
        c = (ord(chunk[2]) - 32) & 0x3f
        d = (ord(chunk[3]) - 32) & 0x3f
        result.append((a << 2) | (b >> 4))
        if count > 1:
            result.append(((b & 0xf) << 4) | (c >> 2))
        if count > 2:
            result.append(((c & 3) << 6) | d)
        count -= 3
        i += 4
sys.stdout.buffer.write(bytes(result))
" > /tmp/test_desync.rar 2>&1; ls -la /tmp/test_desync.rar; od -A x -t x1z /tmp/test_desync.rar | head -20` executed with exit code 0.
